resources.string: Microphone unavailable. Another app may be using it, or access was blocked. PocketMic keeps retrying.
A call or another app is using the microphone, or microphone access is switched off, so your PC hears silence. Sound comes back by itself once the microphone is free.
Android did not let PocketMic start the microphone (%1$s). Open PocketMic and tap Start again.
Use a port in the range %1$d–%2$d
This phone is not on Wi-Fi. Connect it to the same Wi-Fi network as your PC.
Settings can be changed while PocketMic is off.

On your PC, open PocketMic: it finds this phone automatically when both are on the same Wi-Fi. If it does not, type the address shown above into the PC app. In your PC apps, choose \"CABLE Output\" as the microphone.
PocketMic sends this phone\'s microphone to your PC over Wi-Fi, so it needs microphone access.
PocketMic cannot stream without microphone access.
Microphone access was denied, and Android will not ask again. To use PocketMic, open its app settings and allow the microphone under Permissions.
Notifications are off, so the Mute and Stop controls will not appear in the notification shade.
Shown while PocketMic is using the microphone
Mic in use by a call or another app - sending silence
